svg.text: GHOSTED: Ghostie model sheet, sketch v1 (Illustrator, 2026-11-25)

Picked tie: B, slipped (hangs down, off-centre on the arm_L side). Body, crown, 5-scallop hem, size, colours and the tilted rest pose are kept from v5. Hand-drawn Bezier curves; palette rows 16, 27, 10, 22 only.
3/4 (front turned to viewer-left, as v5 hero)
in the 3D toon ramp); drawn here
as a light x0.94 tint. No hue shift.
out of the side. One outline,
no crease, no wedge, no hook.
the eye line at rest. The wave
may reach the eye bottom, never above.
VARIANTS (swap parts; body is the same)
WAVE: arm_L 0 to +40 deg up from rest
Faint blue = rest pose. The flap bends at its root;
the body outline stays closed at the root.
GAME CAMERA x3 (26 m, pitch 42), next to Kit; 1x below
TIE B BUILD SPEC (front view units, body = 280 tall)
Blade: 10 at the knot, 28 at the V
colour, thin ink. Ink: closed line
